items.title: Macapá (AP) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #69
items.en_title: Macapá (AP) Services procurement · accreditation (credenciamento) · closes Nov 26 #69
items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Macapá (AP) is procuring professional or outsourced services through accreditation (credenciamento), with an estimated value of about R$ 495,000; proposals close Nov 26, 17:00 (Brasília time), so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
